import csv, os
p = os.path.join(os.environ['PANTHEON_PROJECTS'], 'survey/cafe.csv')
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(p)))
w = csv.DictWriter(open(p, 'w'), [c for c in rows[0] if c != 'email'], extrasaction='ignore')
w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
